result.title: GraCo: A Unified Toolkit of Graph Coarsening Algorithms and Metrics
result.summary: Graph coarsening aims to reduce a graph to a smaller one that preserves chosen properties of the original. It is increasingly used to scale graph learning to large graphs, as a non-differentiable step applied once before training. Many coarsening methods have been proposed in recent years, each with its own implementation, notation and evaluation. In this work, we introduce GraCo, a unified toolkit of graph coarsening methods. It relies on a single definition: a coarsening is fixed by a partition of the nodes and by the Laplacian the coarsened graph is consistent with. The coarsened graph, and the reduction and lifting matrices that map signals from the original graph to the coarsened one and back, follow from these two choices. We implement 17 methods from the literature and a random baseline, grouped into five families, with the same notation, inputs and outputs. We also build a collection of metrics from different papers, applicable to any coarsening. We check the implementations on a synthetic stochastic block model, then we report the runtime and peak memory of each method on Cora, PubMed, ogbn-arxiv and ogbn-products. GraCo is open-source and available at https://github.com/Antonin-J/graco.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 GraCo，一个图粗化（graph coarsening）方法的统一工具包：以节点划分与对应 Laplacian 为共同定义，统一实现 17 种方法与随机基线，并汇总可复用指标，在合成 SBM 与多个真实图上报告运行时间和峰值内存。
AI.relevance_reason: 内容面向图学习中一次性、不可微的预处理式缩图与工程化评测，不涉及 VLM 推理状态、视觉证据或 latent 生成与使用，也未提供可核查的状态抽象线索，故与 LVR 主线缺少实质联系。
